record.question: Who invented Printing Press?
record.explanation: Answer A: Johannes Gutenberg. Johannes Gutenberg is conventionally credited with introducing movable-type printing in Europe; printing technologies existed earlier in East Asia, so ‘invented printing press’ is a simplified Europe-centered wording. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/biography/Johannes-Gutenberg. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
